nodes.notes: For balanced-core formulations, the corresponding absolute signed bias bound is `1/512`.
nodes.statement_markdown: For `n=2^30`, `D=(1/2-2^-10)n=2^29-2^20=535,822,336`; the durable verified baseline is `RM(1,30)` with `k=31`.

nodes.notes: Rabin's criterion is certified by `Z^(2^16)=Z mod p` and `gcd(p,Z^(2^8)-Z)=1`. Use this `+Z^2` modulus consistently.
nodes.statement_markdown: `p(Z)=Z^16+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1` is irreducible over `F_2`; therefore `F=F_2[Z]/(p)` is an explicitly ordered `F_{2^16}`.

nodes.notes: Let `α=Z mod p` and `A=span_{F_2}{1,α,…,α^14}`. Injectivity follows from `64<|A|`.
nodes.statement_markdown: Evaluating every `f∈F[X]` with `deg f≤64` on ordered `A` gives an exact `[32768,65,32704]_{2^16}` Reed–Solomon/genus-zero AG code.

nodes.notes: For `z=Σz_iα^i`, put `H(z)_y=z_0+Σ_{i=1}^{15}z_i y_i`. `H(1)` has weight 32768; every other nonzero image has weight 16384.
nodes.statement_markdown: `H:F_{2^16}→F_2^{32768}` is a deterministic binary-linear injection with image `RM(1,15)=[32768,16,16384]_2`.

nodes.notes: Define `C(f)_(a,y)=H(f(a))_y`. The message space has dimension `65·16`, and the root bound proves encoder injectivity.
nodes.statement_markdown: `C={C(f):deg f≤64}` is binary linear with exact length `32768^2=2^30` and dimension `65·16=1040`.

nodes.notes: For nonzero `f`, at most 64 outer symbols vanish. Equivalently, `wt(C(f))=2^14(32768-N_0(f)+N_1(f))`. Constants and every other nonzero case are included.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every nonzero word of `C` has weight at least `(32768-64)·16384=535,822,336`.

nodes.notes: For `U=span{1,α,…,α^5}`, the displayed subspace polynomial `L_U` has exactly 64 roots in `A`. The mask `0x007b` separates `1` from `L_U(A)`, so all surviving blocks are balanced.
nodes.statement_markdown: A deterministic degree-64 message attains weight `535,822,336`; hence `d_min(C)=535,822,336` exactly.

nodes.notes: Rows `(j,i)∈{0,…,64}×{0,…,15}` are `C(α^iX^j)`. For each ordered `(a,y)`, compute `α^i a^j mod p` and its affine bit. The bound is `1040·64·16^2·n+O(1040·16n)=O(n)` bit operations at this fixed target, matching the `1040n`-bit output size.
nodes.statement_markdown: A deterministic algorithm outputs the complete `1040×2^30` generator matrix in `n^{O(1)}` time, without search, lookup, padding, or randomness.

nodes.notes: The exact rate is `1040/2^30=65/67,108,864≈9.685754776×10^-7`, a gain of 1009 dimensions over the durable baseline. Equivalent constructions were independently accepted in reviews of algebraic-02, algebraic-03, algebraic-08, algebraic-09, and combinatorial-07.
nodes.statement_markdown: There exists a campaign-explicit binary linear code with exact parameters `[1,073,741,824,1040,535,822,336]_2`. It is the largest admissible proved candidate in the audited corpus.

nodes.notes: The durable leaderboard still records only `k=31`. A write-capable step must persist the proof and record, add minimal reusable lemmas, run the validator/dashboard build, and attach acceptance to the runtime-complete presentation.

summary: All 32 submission JSON files and all 16 available review JSON files were audited. The largest admissible proved construction is the exact RS–affine `[2^30,1040,535822336]_2` code, of rate `65/67,108,864`. Its core has multiple independent accept reviews, and `composition-10` supplies the mandatory deterministic full-generator algorithm. Durable publication remains open because `data/records.json` still lists only k=31. Stronger claims remain correctly demoted: k=2971 is non-explicit; the strongest surviving ordinary-RS gateway is conditional k=1649; and the sharp trace-specific open lemma is a degree-69 subspace with a uniform `4√q` character-sum saving.
